english.meaning: to splash or throw out liquid
english.note: 潑出去嘅水 is a saying, used of a daughter who marries out.

exampleSentences.english: Boys and girls are just different. As they say, a grown daughter won’t stay home—you have to marry her off.
exampleSentences.traditional: 仔同女點都唔同𡃉喎。正所謂女大不中留，要潑出去𡃉喎。
